categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies transaction funding checks in `src/wallet/spend.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Fixes a transaction construction bug where `max_tx_weight` was bypassed if preset inputs already covered the target amount. Because coin selection skipped running, the guard evaluated only `MAX_STANDARD_TX_WEIGHT` instead of `coin_selection_params.m_max_tx_weight`, returning transactions that exceeded the caller's explicit weight constraint.
